allow: PowerShell($p = Start-Process npm -ArgumentList 'run','dev' -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput dev.log -RedirectStandardError deverr.log -NoNewWindow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; Get-Content dev.log -Tail 8; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:5173/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "FETCH ERR: $_" }; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; Get-Content deverr.log -Tail 5)

PowerShell($p = Start-Process -FilePath "npm.cmd" -ArgumentList 'run','dev' -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput dev.log -RedirectStandardError deverr.log -NoNewWindow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 7; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:5173/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; try { $m = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:5173/src/main.tsx -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "MAIN: $\($m.StatusCode\)" } catch { "MAIN ERR: $_" } } catch { "FETCH ERR: $_" }; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; Get-Content dev.log -Tail 6)
